deployments_detail.use: Partnership with Fu2re applying AI and computer vision (SmartAssets) to digitalize the electrical grid and cut connection timelines
EDP reports 500+ AI agents deployed across operations; governed by an AI Management System (AIMS) / Responsible AI policy
Mind4EDP, an internal generative AI assistant deployed to improve project management and workforce productivity across the company.

EDP Renewables uses Appian's low-code + AI automation platform (e.g. EnHanS EHS incident management) to unify siloed data and automate ESG/operations reporting workflows, with 150+ applications built. [Appian]
deployments_detail.value: ~10x ROI; one reporting tool saves 50-75% of an FTE; used by 80%+ of company; 150+ apps

deployments_detail.use: Analytics4Vegetation: E-REDES machine-learning tool that predicts vegetation growth by species near overhead power lines to generate risk alerts, covering 68,000 km of high/medium voltage lines in Portugal.

AI-based inspection of overhead transmission/distribution lines: ML classification of helicopter/drone aerial data plus cognitive image processing to detect defects (rust, broken protections) on poles and components. [Labelec, DefinedCrowd]
PREDIS: AI system for forecasting electricity demand with high accuracy to improve supply-demand balancing.

ElectricDots / EV-charger placement: machine learning and geospatial analytics combining geographical data, customer demand and road information to predict EV charging demand and identify optimal public charger locations. [Microsoft Azure Machine Learning]
Distributed Solar Simulator: AI tool that identifies optimal rooftops for solar expansion and distributed generation.

Power transformer predictions: Azure Machine Learning models predicting power curves for over 100,000 power transformers in Portugal to improve operational preparedness. [Microsoft Azure Machine Learning]

EDP Brazil AI for climate resilience: applying AI to field-operations management and weather forecasting to anticipate extreme weather events and dispatch field teams proactively, plus predictive maintenance/IoT for distributed solar assets.

EDP Ventures $2M (EUR1.8M) investment in a Chilean AI startup developing artificial intelligence technologies applied to renewable energy systems; first EDP Ventures investment in a Latin American startup outside Brazil.
Sentimer chatbot: NLP/ML customer-service assistant for EDP-Carrefour energy contracts in Spain, guiding customers through inquiries and contracting before handoff to human agents.

WhatsApp virtual assistant for retail customer service (EDP Comercial Portugal / EDP Brazil): automated conversational channel for consulting payment data, invoices, e-billing and paying bills (incl. Pix payments in Brazil).
